Red Hat

Senior UX at Red Hat—redhat.com homepage and navigation, then docs.redhat.com and Unified Learn.

← Selected work

I’ve been a senior UX designer at Red Hat since 2021, based in Vermont and working on enterprise digital platforms—first redhat.com, now primarily docs.redhat.com. The work is systems-heavy: big catalogs, embedded engineers, content strategists, and surfaces that have to hold up for years.

Two chapters so far:

redhat.com — homepage, navigation, and research

My first couple of years focused on redhat.com—simplifying a homepage that had been featuring dozens of products, redesigning the global product navigation away from a “wall of products,” refreshing resource page templates, and co-leading Summit research with customers in the room.

Read the case study →

Unified Learn — documentation and learning

Since then I’ve led design on docs.redhat.com (~55k weekday visitors). The platform started as product documentation and has grown into Unified Learn—documentation, learning paths, tutorials, and more under one URL while docs.redhat.com remains the address customers know.

Read the case study →
